review.tagline: Example MCP servers and widgets for ChatGPT apps on the Apps SDK
review.summary: pnpm workspace with React widget sources, a Vite build that emits hashed HTML/JS/CSS bundles served on port 4444, and paired MCP servers in Node and Python (Pizzaz, kitchen-sink-lite, solar system, shopping cart, an OAuth-gated example). Widgets use the window.openai host API and _meta.ui.resourceUri to render inside ChatGPT. For developers building ChatGPT apps; test via developer mode and an ngrok tunnel.
review.audience: Developers building ChatGPT apps with MCP and widgets
strengths: Node and Python MCP servers for the same widgets
kitchen-sink-lite covers the full window.openai host API surface
Shopping-cart example shows widgetSessionId state across tool calls
weaknesses: Examples only; no persistence or deploy config beyond BASE_URL
Requires ChatGPT developer mode and a public tunnel to test
Chrome 142+ needs a flag change to render widgets locally
Maintainers may not review all PRs
needs: TypeScript, OpenAI Apps SDK, MCP TypeScript SDK, MCP Python SDK
Needs ChatGPT developer mode, ngrok or a public host for testing
